scientific_integrity: The exact rational fourth-moment split and full fractional-moment threshold are proved analytically; finite checker tests supplement, not replace, quantifier-level proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two specified two-point reset-amplitude laws and positive linear growth; stationary fractional-moment cutoffs, not pointwise tail asymptotics. Related general perpetuity and generalized Ornstein–Uhlenbeck theorems may imply aspects of the method; independent priority review remains outstanding.
title: Matched reset-size statistics conceal a finite-versus-infinite stationary fourth moment
